recipe.source_geometry: Actual current G7 XYZ, including its retained old-G4 vertex prefix; no earlier XYZ is substituted.
recipe.context_provenance: Required bool[nc] lift_maps[0][source_body_vertex_mask]; runner binds exact preserved G4 parent_face -> G3 face_event_ids and includes only controls whose every incident parent event is zero.
recipe.local_chart: t=chart[:,0]; theta=atan2(abs(chart[:,2]),abs(chart[:,1])). Only verified canonical x<0,y>0 local context is inverted.
recipe.major_component_lobe_basis: Independent read-only source-envelope audit: actual main-component radial maxima at theta .40690, .78494 and 1.11761; corresponding prominence .03050, .11718 and .06538. Weak seam near .603 is not assigned a new equal lobe.
recipe.major_component_kernel: K(u)=max(0,1-u*u)^3 for abs(u)<1, zero otherwise; u=(theta-centre)/.30. Compact C2 kernel.
recipe.lobe_partition: Normalize three compact C2 angular kernels within the same actual EDGE-connected 406-control component; reject any uncovered component control. No infinite tails or gap/component bridging.
recipe.profile: Quintic Bezier: P0=source(t0,theta), P1=P0+.18L*T0, P2=P0+1.20*(P5-P0)+A*N, P3=P0-.20*(P5-P0)+.82*A*N, P4=P5-.18L*T1, P5=source(t1,theta).
recipe.profile_scope: One fixed asymmetric rounded-fold profile; its actual sampled tangent turn is reported. A C-shaped return or visual success is not assumed.
recipe.crest_normal: N=normalized XY radial direction at the mean source endpoint; guide T=endpoint chord projected off N and oriented +Z.
recipe.endpoint_tangents: Actual source outside finite differences, normalized and sign-oriented to the forward endpoint chord. Tangent control length=.18*endpoint chord length.
recipe.radial_envelope: Actual source G7 radial maxima inside each lifted local lobe, binned by theta; endpoint and A=0 profile radial maxima provide explicit necessary floors.
recipe.radial_calibration: For each fixed theta sample, solve A once so the 81-sample profile maximum XY radius reaches its measured/floored envelope. Interpolate calibrated A in theta with PCHIP.
recipe.mask_promotion: quintic_smoothstep(clip(coarse_mask/.30,0,1)); multiply actual component/lobe membership before linear V/E/F lifting.
recipe.final_blend: Lift actual scalar component memberships; multiply by quintic endpoint feather. Sum membership*(rebuilt_target-actual_G7_source), never lift a coarse displacement.
recipe.reflection: Frozen whole_field._transport after actual source-ID canonical delta reflection; preserve original source coordinates and source residuals.
recipe.displacement_cap: D *= B*tanh(norm(D)/B)/norm(D), B=.025H. Applied to final transported local vector; cap/feather may reduce the calibrated profile peak.
recipe.preservation: Exact source where aggregate blend mask is zero. Faces, classes, rest, anchors, chart and all original IDs remain unchanged.
recipe.interpretation: One local end-shape reconstruction authorized by the user, preserving the large source flow outside the marked support. No collision repair, fabrication certification or G1 guarantee.

local_source_interpolation.method: scipy LinearNDInterpolator on actual current-G7 coarse-prefix canonical original-body local WALL UV only; all nonzero preserved-G3-event incident controls excluded

Complete actual operator metadata and recipe are retained verbatim; rendering applies no geometry processing. Naturalness and aesthetic success are not certified by technical checks.
